sql_templates.sql: SELECT r.project_id,r.revision_id,r.artifact_id,r.kind,r.input_refs,r.audience, CASE WHEN r.kind='VoiceProfile' THEN r.payload->>'voice_kind' END AS catalog_voice_kind, jsonb_build_object( 'edges',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)) FROM artifact_dependencies e WHERE e.project_id=r.project_id AND e.consumer_id=r.revision_id),'[]'::jsonb), 'events',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(d.payload::jsonb ORDER BY (d.payload->>'expected_validity_version')::bigint) FROM dependency_revalidations d WHERE d.project_id=r.project_id AND d.subject_id=r.revision_id AND (d.acceptance_record_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM revocations v WHERE v.project_id=d.project_id AND v.acceptance_record_id=d.acceptance_record_id))), '[]'::jsonb), 'privacy',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(l.input_id) FROM revalidation_privacy_links l WHERE l.project_id=r.project_id AND l.subject_id=r.revision_id),'[]'::jsonb), 'blobs',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b)||jsonb_build_object( 'binding_purpose',a.purpose, 'access_revoked',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM blob_access_revocations v WHERE v.project_id=b.project_id AND v.sha256=b.sha256), 'evaluator_only',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM evaluator_blob_classifications c WHERE c.project_id=b.project_id AND c.sha256=b.sha256))) FROM artifact_blobs a JOIN blobs b USING(project_id,storage_key) WHERE a.project_id=r.project_id AND a.revision_id=r.revision_id),'[]'::jsonb), 'invalid',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invalidations i WHERE i.project_id=r.project_id AND i.revision_id=r.revision_id AND i.category='access'), 'runtimes',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'record_id',l.record_id,'record_kind',l.record_kind)) FROM runtime_links l WHERE l.project_id=r.project_id AND l.revision_id=r.revision_id),'[]'::jsonb) ) AS access_graph FROM artifact_revisions r WHERE r.revision_id=ANY(%(ids)s)

WITH RECURSIVE runtime_reach(record_id) AS ( SELECT unnest(CAST(%(ids)s AS uuid[])) UNION SELECT edge.target_record_id FROM runtime_runtime_refs edge JOIN runtime_reach parent ON edge.record_id=parent.record_id WHERE edge.project_id=%(p)s AND NOT(edge.target_record_id=ANY(CAST(%(known)s AS uuid[]))) ) SELECT r.project_id,r.record_id,r.record_kind,r.audience, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'artifact_id',a.artifact_id,'revision_id',a.revision_id,'kind',a.kind)) FROM runtime_artifact_refs a WHERE a.project_id=r.project_id AND a.record_id=r.record_id), '[]'::jsonb) AS artifact_references, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'record_id',a.target_record_id,'record_kind',a.record_kind)) FROM runtime_runtime_refs a WHERE a.project_id=r.project_id AND a.record_id=r.record_id), '[]'::jsonb) AS runtime_references, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'storage_key',a.storage_key,'sha256',a.sha256,'byte_length',a.byte_length,'media_type',a.media_type)) FROM runtime_blob_refs a WHERE a.project_id=r.project_id AND a.record_id=r.record_id), '[]'::jsonb) AS blob_references FROM runtime_records r JOIN runtime_reach n ON r.record_id=n.record_id WHERE r.project_id=%(p)s AND NOT(r.record_id=ANY(CAST(%(known)s AS uuid[])))
SELECT role FROM project_members WHERE project_id=%(p)s AND actor_id=%(a)s
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY
SELECT payload FROM runtime_records WHERE project_id=%(p)s AND record_id=%(r)s AND record_kind=%(k)s

SELECT b.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM blob_access_revocations v WHERE v.project_id=b.project_id AND v.sha256=b.sha256) AS access_revoked, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM evaluator_blob_classifications c WHERE c.project_id=b.project_id AND c.sha256=b.sha256) AS evaluator_only FROM blobs b WHERE project_id=%(p)s AND storage_key=ANY(%(keys)s)
